description: This file defines function prototypes for drawing 2D shapes (circle, ellipse, rect, square, line, arc, point, quad, triangle, beginShape, vertex, endShape) using Lua bindings, including documentation and examples. It also includes conditional GLFW header inclusion.

methods.name: circle
methods.description: Draws a circle on the screen with specified center and diameter.

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse on the screen with specified center, width, and height.

methods.name: rect
methods.description: Draws a rectangle on the screen with specified top-left corner, width, and height.

methods.name: square
methods.description: Draws a square on the screen with specified top-left corner and side length.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Draws a line between two points.

methods.name: arc
methods.description: Draws an arc with specified position, size, and start/stop angles.

methods.name: point
methods.description: Draws a point at specified coordinates.

methods.name: quad
methods.description: Draws a quadrilateral with four specified vertices.

methods.name: triangle
methods.description: Draws a triangle with three specified vertices.

methods.name: beginShape
methods.description: Starts defining a custom shape with vertices.

methods.name: vertex
methods.description: Adds a vertex to the current shape.
